title: Funnels for Kitchen Use, Food Grade Silicone Collapsible Kitchen Funnel (Black)
description:
About this item
FOOD GRADE SILICONE: The kitchen funnel is made by soft and flexible silicone, BPA Free, heat resistant -40°F to 392°F, No need to worry that the funnel may damage the health of your families.
EASY TO CLEAN: These funnels are convenient for anyone in the family to use, they are very easy to clean, just simple wash with warm water and add little soap, or put them in the dishwasher.
SPACE SAVER IN KITCHEN: Silicone folding funnel, it can be easily hang on the wall or neatly put away in a drawer to save effective space in the kitchen.
WIDE APPLICATION: The kitchen funnel can transfer liquids, fine powder, small particles etc., and the kitchen funnel is suitable for almost any containers.
100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEED: Your satisfaction is our ultimate goal. If you have any problems with the product you have purchased, please let us know and we will replace it with a product or refund it for you.
reviews_5s:
I bought this to fill water jugs from our RO Filter tap on the sink and it has worked perfectly for that. But, it has come in handy for so many other things from transferring liquids like oil olive from a large can to filling spice jars from bulk backs. Being able to fold it down flat for storing in a drawer is perfect. Takes up no space, so it replaced my solid metal funnels. A great kitchen tool that gets used a lot.Perfect for a water bottle when you can't just "dump" powder into it. Easy clean up too.Just what I needed. Collapses to fit in less space, useful size when extended.These are great but I almost got kicked out of a casino using one to pour tequila into my beer, which is why I bought them in the first place.

The tequila was free in the VIP lounge and so was the beer. To the cameras, for some reason, it looked like I was filling up an empty beer bottle to take the tequila home with me. I know, who brings a funnel into a casino to transfer tequila into a beer bottle full of beer.

Not me, not anymore. I just pour it in and plenty of it goes on the ground. They prefer that, I guess, so I'm going with their way from now on.Works like a charm , easy to clean 🧽Bigger than I thoughGreat rubbery funnel. Lays flat for storage. I use it in my kitchen.Multi use funnel, practical for use in the kitchenUse this for resin in 3d printers. Resin doesn't stick to silicon so it works great.Meet my needs
reviews_1s:
Not even close to the funnel described & pictured on Amazon. No grip/hanging tab, no tip at the bottom, and an inch shorter. Also, the top edge looks like a child cut ot with scissors. See pics.I bought this to pour protein powder into bottles and it did not work very well at all. The powder sticks to the rubbery texture and does not pour through. If you are only using this for liquid you might be alright.This was inexpensive and made sense for space purposes, but after trying to use it several times, it's essentially useless for what i purchased it for.

The ridges ensure virtually any product gets caught, requiring work to dislodge or otherwise waste, and the hole is too small to be useful for anything other than liquid or perhaps ground coffee. I'm glad it was at least under $5.Click to play video
As soon as liquid is poured into funnel the weight of the liquid compresses the funnel in such a way that it will only drip through. For my purposes--kefir brewing--this means that when I'm trying to bottle the beverage the rate of flow from the large container cannot be contained by the slow drip, leading to spillage. There is no workaround. This product does not work at all for this purpose. See video for demonstration.Dry products (spices, sugar, etc.) just stick inside - no flow; liquid backs up unless funnel is lifted up away from top of bottle; warm sauces cause funnel to collapse and spill out. Basically useless purchase. I didn’t even have the heart to pass the thing on to the local flea market - just tossed it.The silicone picked up scent from something around it. The silicone funnel stinks like a dirty dollar store- musty, dusty, with the smell of cheap perfume, off-gassing plastics and moth balls. Effn gross. I’m not pouring any food into this funnel! Or anything at all for that matter 🤢After owning this for almost 3 months (and using it maybe 3 or 4 times), I was drying the silicone funnel after washing it, and at the seam near the smallest portion of the funnel it broke off.Cheap and flimsy - collapses too easy and isn't sturdy. Save your money and choose another brandI've only been using this product for 2 months and it ripped.The absolute worst product I have bought in a while. Every thing I had intended to use this item for got trapped in the collapsed crevices and would clog the hole. Never in my life has a product had one job and failed so miserably at completing a simple task.
